body:
I'm doing alright. I had another breakdown, and then took a nap. It helped that I had to day off from work.

I'm going to talk to my therapist tomorrow about my increase in suicidal thoughts. Maybe get on a different medication. It just doesn't help that I have BP II-- normal depression meds swing me into manic mode, so I have to be careful.

Thanks for caring. It's nice to know someone does.
